verdict: Strong 28-day ROAS, but weekly efficiency is slipping and needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $4.86 for every $1 spent across $1,482.32 in spend — a healthy floor. However, that efficiency eroded week-over-week: despite purchases jumping 75% in the most recent week, the return on that spend dropped roughly 40%, a sign that daily purchase activity is uneven and a handful of large orders have been carrying the 28-day number. Separately, your Google Business Profile went dark for three consecutive days (Aug 6–8), pulling local engagement down 56% versus the prior week — this is a local visibility issue, not an ads issue, and it's being addressed now. Ad creative is also showing early fatigue signs, with Instagram reach declining around 40% from mid-July levels, and a creative refresh is in motion ahead of the Aug 14 live-cooking shoot. Expect steadier daily purchase activity and renewed local engagement as those actions take effect next week.
